report_name: Uber Fined €825M by Dutch Regulator Over Automated Driver Deactivations

identities.name: Uber
identities.description: Fined €825 million by the Dutch Data Protection Authority for using fully automated systems to suspend and deactivate driver accounts between 2018 and 2022, in violation of GDPR Article 22. The company's Dutch subsidiary is Uber B.V. and its parent is Uber Technologies, Inc.

identities.name: Dutch Data Protection Authority
identities.description: The Dutch regulatory body (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens) that imposed an €825 million GDPR fine on Uber for its automated decision-making practices affecting drivers.

identities.name: Uber Drivers
identities.description: A class of individuals whose accounts were suspended or deactivated by Uber's automated systems without meaningful human review, leading to a GDPR violation.
